title: 第5章 他喜欢看她哭
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
安怜：……

    一波刚平一波又起。

    她真想连夜扛着行李逃跑，但她没钱。

    她现在跑路，到了北方冰雪王国连房租都付不起，她可不想睡大街。

    安怜在心里把江彻骂了一百八十遍，面上却扬起一个乖巧的笑容：“哥哥不觉得丝巾配我这套衣服很好看吗？”

    叶闻白上下打量了她几眼。

    小姑娘今天穿了一件浅蓝色的连衣裙，头发散在肩上，系了一条米白色的丝巾。

    说实话，搭配得确实不错，丝巾正好点缀了脖颈处空荡荡的位置，看起来很温柔。

    “是挺好看的。”叶闻白说。

    安怜松了口气，刚想笑，又听见他补了一句：“不过——”

    她的心又提了起来，吊在半空中晃晃悠悠的，怎么也落不下来。

    叶闻白看着她那这紧张兮兮的小表情，把后半句咽了回去。

    算了。

    他刚才已经把人惹哭过一次了，要是再追问下去，这小哭包估计又得掉眼泪。

    虽然他挺喜欢看她哭的，但再来一次他可招架不住。

    “不过什么？”安怜小心翼翼地追问。

    “不过我们家怜儿穿什么都好看。”叶闻白笑着说，伸手揉了揉她的发顶，“就算不系丝巾，也好看。”

    安怜一愣，旋即脸颊染上一层薄粉，分不清是害羞还是紧张。

    她低下头，手指绞着衣角，小声嘟囔：“我才不是哥哥家的……”

    声音小得像蚊子哼哼，但叶闻白听得一清二楚。

    他垂眸看着她红扑扑的脸蛋，嘴角的弧度深了几分。

    不急。

    反正早晚有一天，他会把她娶回家。

    “走吧，我送你去教室。”叶闻白牵起安怜的手，十指扣进她的指缝里，“早餐吃不下就不吃了，别勉强。”

    安怜神情微滞，欲言又止。

    叶闻白怎么知道她吃不下？

    嗯……好像刚才是有点明显。

    不过他没拆穿她就行。

    “好。”安怜乖乖点头，任由叶闻白牵着往前走。
content_en:
An Lian:......

    One wave just subsides and another wave rises.

    She really wanted to carry her luggage and run away overnight, but she had no money.

    She is now on the run. She can't even pay the rent in the Northern Ice and Snow Kingdom. She doesn't want to sleep on the street.

    An Lian scolded Jiang Che a hundred and eighty times in her heart, but a sweet smile appeared on her face: "Brother, don't you think the silk scarf looks good with my outfit?"

    Ye Wenbai looked her up and down.

    The little girl wore a light blue dress today, with her hair spread over her shoulders and an off-white silk scarf.

    To be honest, the matching is really good. The silk scarf just embellishes the empty space on the neck and looks very gentle.

    "It's quite beautiful." Ye Wenbai said.

    An Lian breathed a sigh of relief and was about to laugh when she heard him add: "But-"

    Her heart was lifted again, dangling in the air, unable to fall down.

    Ye Wenbai looked at her nervous expression and swallowed back the second half of the sentence.

    never mind.

    He has already made someone cry once. If he continues to ask questions, this little crybaby will probably shed tears again.

    Although he enjoyed watching her cry, he couldn't resist it again.

    "But what?" An Lian asked cautiously.

    "But our Lian'er looks good in anything she wears." Ye Wenbai said with a smile, reaching out to rub the top of her hair, "Even if she doesn't wear a scarf, she still looks good."

    An Lian was stunned for a moment, and soon her cheeks were stained with a thin layer of pink. She couldn't tell whether it was from shyness or nervousness.

    She lowered her head, twisted her clothes with her fingers, and muttered in a low voice: "I'm not from my brother's family..."

    The sound was as low as a mosquito's hum, but Ye Wenbai heard it clearly.

    He lowered his eyes and looked at her flushed face, and the curve of the corners of his mouth deepened a little.

    No rush.

    Anyway, sooner or later, he will marry her home.

    "Let's go, I'll take you to the classroom." Ye Wenbai took An Lian's hand and clasped his fingers between hers, "If you can't eat breakfast, just eat it. Don't force it."

    An Lian's expression was slightly stagnant, and he stopped talking.

    How did Ye Wenbai know that she couldn't eat it?

    Hmm...it seemed a little obvious just now.

    But as long as he didn't expose her.

    "Okay." An Lian nodded obediently and let Ye Wenbai lead him forward.
